name: Leh Berry Shot
subtitle: sea buckthorn, which grows wild across Ladakh

ingredients.note: the berries are fiercely tart and full of seed
it needs the sweetness more than most

steps.text: If starting from berries, blend with 60ml water and strain twice; the seeds are hard and must not go through.
Combine the sea buckthorn juice with the orange juice.
Stir in the honey until it dissolves, and the grated ginger if using.
Serve cold in two small glasses.

provenance.note: Sea buckthorn grows wild along the Indus in Ladakh, where it is called leh berry and has been made into juice and jam long before the wellness trade found it. The Ladakh Autonomous Hill Council has promoted it as a local crop for years.
